title: A Shared Standard for Valid Measurement of Generative AI Systems’ Capabilities, Risks, and Impacts

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct an empirical evaluation but uses a hypothetical case study to illustrate its proposed measurement framework. It outlines a methodology for measuring negative stereotyping in a conversational search engine using automated annotation guidelines, representing data as conversation history triples, and applying an inverse probability weighted estimator on sampled user logs.
